findings.summary: The config sets only defaults.mode: shadow and has no per-judgment overrides, so every judgment is in shadow by default. If a later schema change makes the default something other than shadow, nothing in this file would stop that. Consider listing the judgments explicitly when promotion work begins. This is not a defect today.

findings.summary: egress.allow lets three kinds of repository data go to the third-party Jev provider: work-item-text, code-diff and agent-output. Only work-item-text judgment definitions exist today. The redaction layer applies, every judgment is in shadow, and the operator ordered this in AISDLC-641 step 2, so it is acceptable. Consider narrowing the list to the classes that existing judgments use until a judgment needs the others.
